5.20.040: Editor's note(s)—Ord. No. 676, §§ 1, 2, adopted Dec. 15, 2022, repealed the former § 5.20.040 and enacted a new § 5.20.040 as set out herein. The former § 5.20.040 pertained to peddlers, hawkers and street vendors and derived from Ord. 232 § 7-4, adopted in 1977.
5.20.100: Editor's note(s)—Ord. No. 569, § 1, adopted December 5, 2011, in effect repealed the former § 5.20.100, and enacted a new § 5.20.100 as set out herein. The former § 5.20.100 pertained to garbage, trash, refuse disposal and refuse transfer station and derived from Ord. No. 232, 1977.
5.20.125: Editor's note(s)—Ord. No. 627, adopted November 7, 2017, set out provisions intended for use as § 5.20.12. For purposes of classification, and at the editor's discretion, these provisions have been included as § 5.20.125.
